l2Support: The Priority Intervention programme gives extra teachers to schools with many foreign pupils
'Portuguese as a Non-Native Language', taught in parallel with mainstream Portuguese
Alone of the six countries compared, that support is targeted rather than universal
It is not a quota, and the EC study behind the comparison prefers universal schemes
